hypotheses.tail_coverage: Increasing coverage of [-135,-115]mV reduces the K_Pst edge error at equal tuple count and training budget.
hypotheses.tau_weight: Increasing log_tau loss weight from0.01 to0.1 improves rate and transition fidelity without sacrificing inf or open probability.
hypotheses.capacity: Width64 improves matched diagnostics beyond width32 at identical seed, data and optimization.
hypotheses.budget: Extending the same trajectory from15k through30k to60k closes the remaining gap.

selection: One common sampling/weight/width/checkpoint for all three seeds chosen by minimum worst-seed development score across uniform and negative-tail domains. Score=max_domain(gate_rmse/.001+gate_max/.01+inf_rmse/.002+log_tau_rmse/.02). Fresh outcomes inaccessible until freeze.
promotion: All three frozen seeds must pass unchanged gates on both fresh in-support and fresh negative-tail strata. OOD diagnostic only. Retain prior Ca/Na bounded successes; no universal or embedded replacement claim.
limits: 24 independently parameterized models in two width ensembles; no weight sharing. Tail enrichment replaces25percent of voltages only; states/dt/index streams paired. All loss arms rate-supervised; inf weight0.1; Adam lr0.003 and independent clip1.0. Formula/LUT references unchanged.
